intervention_execution.claim: Each accepted bounded shared delta is applied to the actual head and becomes the next relinearization state.

intended_intermediate.claim: Original plus accepted memberships enter later constraints and are checked on every native trial.

observable_output.claim: Both heads strictly accumulate0->1->2->3 rescues with zero original or accepted loss.

primary_explanation.statement: The earlier one-step effect is not an isolated near-tie: relinearization plus accepted-rescue protection permits cumulative fitted movement.

alternative_explanations.statement: The gains may merely memorize the59 supervised boundaries and fail on unseen questions.
Quantum and classical geometries may differ beyond the fixed three-step cap, but this run provides no quantum advantage signal.

discriminating_measurement.uncertainty: Do training-fitted sequential updates improve Top5 membership on untouched questions?
discriminating_measurement.measurement: Freeze unseen questions before fitting, fit only on training59, and compare identity, quantum and matched classical final heads without tuning.
discriminating_measurement.primary_outcome: Quantum improves direct/useful untouched membership without protected regression and exceeds matched classical uncertainty.
discriminating_measurement.alternative_outcome: Training rescues do not transfer, or classical matches/exceeds quantum.

forbidden_rescue_variants: Raise the three-step cap and report extra fitted rescues as task progress
Interpret equal quantum/classical rescue counts as quantum advantage

positive_carryovers.mechanism: Update the actual shared head, recompute its exact local boundary, and promote every accepted rescue into later protection.
positive_carryovers.transport_constraint: Train labels may shape training updates but may never enter unseen inference or evaluation selection.

positive_carryovers.mechanism: Reject linear proposals unless actual all-question Top5 membership strictly improves with zero protected loss.
positive_carryovers.transport_constraint: Keep all50 candidates, identity null and matched classical control.

selected_candidate.title: Preregistered unseen-question gate for sequential quantum Reader updates
selected_candidate.causal_difference: Move the judgment boundary from fitted training rescue to untouched question membership while keeping the fitted head and inference target-blind.
selected_candidate.discriminating_measurement: Direct/useful Top5 membership on a cohort frozen before any training update, with identity and matched classical controls.
selected_candidate.success_gate: Positive untouched effect with zero protected regression and uncertainty excluding no improvement; quantum-specific claim additionally requires matched-classical separation.
selected_candidate.kill_condition: No untouched benefit or any protected regression; stop this training objective rather than retune on exposed questions.
selected_candidate.authorization_boundary: Proposal only; requires a new preregistration and explicit execution authorization.
